title: Website Designing
summary: Fast, modern, mobile-first websites that actually convert visitors into customers.
seoDescription: Custom, mobile-first website design built to convert visitors into customers.
imageAlt: Before and after comparison of an outdated business website versus a modern StarBlaze-designed website
body:
Your website is often the first impression a customer has of your business — StarBlaze designs websites that load fast, look professional on any device, and are built to turn visitors into enquiries or sales, not just look pretty.

**What's included:**

- Custom design tailored to your brand — not a generic template
- Mobile-first, fast-loading pages
- Clear calls-to-action built around your actual business goals
- Basic on-page SEO from day one

**Who it's for:** Businesses that don't have a website yet, or have one that's outdated, slow, or doesn't reflect the business anymore.

process.title: Discovery
process.text: We learn about your business, customers and goals, and agree on what the site needs to do.

process.title: Design
process.text: You see a custom design for your key pages before anything is built, and we refine it with your feedback.

process.title: Build
process.text: We develop a fast, mobile-first site with the content, forms and calls-to-action in place.

process.title: Launch & support
process.text: We test across devices, take the site live, and stay available for fixes and updates.

benefits: A professional first impression on phones and desktops
Pages that load quickly, which helps visitors stay and search engines rank you
Clear paths for visitors to call, message or buy
A site you can grow instead of rebuilding later

faq.q: Will you use a ready-made template?
faq.a: No. The design is built around your brand and goals rather than a generic template.

faq.q: Do I need to write all the content?
faq.a: Share what you have and we will help shape it. Tell us up front if you need help with copy or images.

faq.q: Can I update the site myself later?
faq.a: Tell us how hands-on you want to be and we will set it up to suit that, or handle updates for you.

faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: It depends on the number of pages and how quickly content and feedback come in. We will give you a clear timeline once we know the scope.

title: Fully Managed Website Hosting
summary: We keep your site online, secure, and fast — so you never have to think about servers.
seoTitle: Fully Managed Website Hosting | StarBlaze Ventures
seoDescription: Managed website hosting with backups, security monitoring, and direct support.
imageAlt: Server uptime dashboard showing green status indicators
body:
Website hosting shouldn't be something you have to learn. We handle server setup, security updates, backups, uptime monitoring, and renewals — if anything goes wrong, we're the ones who get the alert, not you.

**What's included:**

- Server setup and configuration
- Regular backups
- Security monitoring and updates
- Uptime monitoring
- Direct support when something needs fixing

**Who it's for:** Any business that wants their website to just work, without managing a hosting account, renewals, or technical issues themselves.

process.title: Assessment
process.text: We review your site and decide the right server setup for its size and traffic.

process.title: Setup & migration
process.text: We configure the server and move your site across, keeping downtime to a minimum.

process.title: Monitoring
process.text: Backups, security updates and uptime checks run continuously in the background.

process.title: Support
process.text: If something breaks, we get the alert and fix it. You do not have to chase anyone.

benefits: No hosting accounts, renewals or server settings to manage
Regular backups so a mistake or an attack is recoverable
Issues spotted and handled before most visitors notice
One team to call when anything goes wrong

faq.q: Can you host a site that someone else built?
faq.a: In most cases, yes. We review it first and tell you if anything needs to change.

faq.q: What happens to my domain?
faq.a: Your domain stays yours. We can work with the registrar you already use.

faq.q: How often are backups taken?
faq.a: We will agree a backup schedule that fits how often your site changes.

faq.q: What if my site goes down?
faq.a: Uptime monitoring alerts us straight away and we start fixing it.

title: Managed Cloud Services
summary: Cloud infrastructure, set up and maintained for you, sized to what your business actually needs.
seoDescription: Right-sized cloud infrastructure setup, monitoring, and maintenance.
imageAlt: Cloud infrastructure diagram showing connected services
body:
Whether it's email, file storage, business applications, or backend infrastructure for your own product, we set up and manage cloud services sized to your business — not an enterprise package you'll never fully use, and not a bare-bones setup that breaks under real usage.

**What's included:**

- Cloud environment setup and configuration
- Ongoing monitoring and maintenance
- Scaling guidance as your business grows
- Cost optimization — right-sized, not over-provisioned

**Who it's for:** Businesses running internal tools, apps, or infrastructure that needs a managed cloud setup instead of ad-hoc, unmanaged servers.

process.title: Requirements review
process.text: We look at what you run today, what you plan to run, and what it costs.

process.title: Right-sized design
process.text: We propose a cloud setup that matches your real usage, with room to grow.

process.title: Setup & migration
process.text: We build the environment and move your workloads over in a planned way.

process.title: Operate & optimize
process.text: We monitor, maintain and tune the setup, and review costs as your usage changes.

benefits: Infrastructure sized to your business, not oversized or fragile
Ongoing monitoring and maintenance handled for you
Clearer, more controlled cloud costs
Guidance on when and how to scale

faq.q: Which cloud providers do you work with?
faq.a: Tell us what you use or prefer and we will advise on the best fit for your needs.

faq.q: Can you manage our existing setup?
faq.a: Usually yes. We start with a review of what is already running.

faq.q: Can you help reduce our cloud bill?
faq.a: Right-sizing and removing unused resources are part of the service, and we review them regularly.

faq.q: Do you offer email and file storage setup?
faq.a: Yes. Email, file storage and business applications are all covered.

title: GMB Services
summary: Get found on Google Maps and Search, with a Business Profile that's fully optimized and kept up to date.
seoTitle: Google Business Profile (GMB) Services | StarBlaze Ventures
seoDescription: Google Business Profile setup, optimization, and ongoing management.
imageAlt: Google Business Profile listing showing reviews, photos, and business hours
body:
Most local customers check Google before they check anything else. We set up and optimize your Google Business Profile — accurate hours, photos, categories, posts, and review management — so you show up, and show up well, when someone nearby searches for what you offer.

**What's included:**

- Google Business Profile setup or clean-up
- Ongoing posts and updates
- Review monitoring and response support
- Local SEO improvements tied to your GMB listing

**Who it's for:** Any business with a physical location or local service area that wants to show up in "near me" searches and Google Maps.

process.title: Profile audit
process.text: We check your current Google Business Profile for gaps, errors and missed opportunities.

process.title: Set up & optimize
process.text: We fix or create the profile with accurate details, categories, photos and descriptions.

process.title: Post & update
process.text: We publish regular posts and keep hours and information current.

process.title: Reviews & reporting
process.text: We monitor reviews, help you respond, and keep improving your local visibility.

benefits: A more complete, trustworthy profile when people search nearby
Better chances of appearing in Google Maps and local results
Reviews monitored and answered promptly
Fresh content that shows customers you are open and active

faq.q: I already have a Google Business Profile. Can you still help?
faq.a: Yes. We clean up and improve existing profiles as well as create new ones.

faq.q: Can you guarantee a top ranking?
faq.a: No one can promise a specific position on Google. We focus on the profile quality and activity that improve your chances.

faq.q: Do you reply to reviews for us?
faq.a: We provide review monitoring and response support, and we agree the tone with you first.

faq.q: Does this work for service-area businesses?
faq.a: Yes, including businesses without a shop front.

title: AI & Automation
summary: Automate the repetitive parts of your business with AI tools built around how you actually work.
seoDescription: Custom AI automation for customer queries, lead handling, and internal workflows.
imageAlt: Automated workflow diagram showing AI handling customer queries and routing leads
body:
From answering common customer questions to organizing leads to generating first drafts of content, we build AI-powered automations around your actual workflows — not generic chatbots, but tools shaped around how your business really operates.

**What's included:**

- Workflow audit to find what's worth automating
- Custom AI automation setup (chat, lead handling, content, internal tools)
- Integration with tools you already use
- Ongoing tuning as your needs change

**Who it's for:** Businesses spending too much time on repetitive tasks — answering the same questions, manually sorting leads, or copy-pasting information between tools.

process.title: Workflow audit
process.text: We map where your team's time goes and pick the tasks worth automating first.

process.title: Design
process.text: We plan the automation around your workflow and the tools you already use.

process.title: Build & integrate
process.text: We set up the AI automation and connect it to your existing systems.

process.title: Tune & improve
process.text: We watch how it performs and adjust it as your needs change.

benefits: Less time spent on repetitive questions and manual data entry
Faster, more consistent responses to customers and leads
Automations shaped around your business instead of a generic bot
Works alongside the tools you already use

faq.q: Do I need technical knowledge?
faq.a: No. We handle the setup and explain how it works in plain language.

faq.q: Will AI replace my team?
faq.a: The goal is to remove repetitive work so your team can focus on the work that needs a person.

faq.q: Can it connect to our existing tools?
faq.a: In most cases, yes. We confirm what can be integrated during the audit.

faq.q: What does it cost to run?
faq.a: It depends on the tools and usage involved. We explain any ongoing costs up front.

title: WhatsApp Marketing & Automation
summary: Reach customers where they already are, with automated flows that feel personal.
seoDescription: WhatsApp Business API setup, automated flows, and broadcast campaign management.
imageAlt: WhatsApp Business chat showing an automated order confirmation flow
body:
WhatsApp is where your customers already are. We build automated flows for order updates, broadcast campaigns, catalog sharing, and customer support — set up properly so it feels responsive and personal, not like a mass-blast spam channel.

**What's included:**

- WhatsApp Business API setup
- Automated flows (order updates, FAQs, catalog sharing)
- Broadcast campaign setup and management
- Integration with your existing sales/support process

**Who it's for:** Businesses that want to sell, support, and follow up with customers directly over WhatsApp without doing it all manually.

process.title: Goals & audience
process.text: We decide what you want WhatsApp to do: sell, support, follow up, or all three.

process.title: Account setup
process.text: We set up WhatsApp Business API access and the messaging basics.

process.title: Flows & campaigns
process.text: We build your automated replies, order updates, catalog sharing and broadcasts.

process.title: Launch & refine
process.text: We go live, review results, and improve the flows over time.

benefits: Faster replies to customers without someone watching the phone all day
Order updates and FAQs handled automatically
Broadcasts that are planned and managed rather than spammy
Conversations that feed into your existing sales and support process

faq.q: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?
faq.a: For many automated flows, yes. We help you set it up as part of the service.

faq.q: Will customers get unwanted messages?
faq.a: We design flows around customers who have opted in and keep campaigns relevant.

faq.q: Can I see an example flow?
faq.a: Contact us and we will walk you through examples that fit your type of business.

faq.q: Do you also sell WhatsApp software?
faq.a: Yes. See our Store for the WhatsApp Automation Platform and WhatsApp Bulk Sender.

title: Performance Marketing
summary: Paid campaigns built around measurable return, not vanity metrics.
seoDescription: Paid campaign strategy, setup, and optimization across Google, Meta, and more.
imageAlt: Marketing analytics dashboard showing ad spend and conversion metrics
body:
We run paid campaigns across the platforms that matter for your business — built, tracked, and optimized around actual return on ad spend, not follower counts or impressions that don't turn into revenue.

**What's included:**

- Campaign strategy and setup (Google, Meta, and other relevant platforms)
- Conversion tracking so you know what's actually working
- Ongoing optimization based on real performance data
- Regular, plain-language reporting

**Who it's for:** Businesses ready to spend on advertising but want it managed properly, with clear accountability for the results.

process.title: Goals & tracking
process.text: We agree on what a good result looks like and set up conversion tracking.

process.title: Campaign build
process.text: We create campaigns on the platforms that suit your audience and budget.

process.title: Optimize
process.text: We adjust targeting, creative and spend based on real performance data.

process.title: Report
process.text: You get regular, plain-language reports showing what you spent and what it returned.

benefits: Ad spend tied to results you can measure
Clear tracking of which campaigns bring enquiries or sales
Ongoing optimization rather than set-and-forget
Reporting you can read without marketing jargon

faq.q: Which platforms do you run ads on?
faq.a: Google and Meta are the usual starting points, and we add others when they make sense for your business.

faq.q: Is the ad budget included?
faq.a: Ad spend is paid to the platforms separately from our management. We help you set a budget that fits your goals.

faq.q: How soon will I see results?
faq.a: It varies by industry and budget. We set realistic expectations once we have reviewed your market.

faq.q: Do you guarantee sales?
faq.a: No one can honestly guarantee that. We commit to proper tracking, clear reporting and continuous improvement.

title: Social Media Management
summary: Consistent, on-brand presence across your social channels, without you lifting a finger.
seoDescription: Content planning, creation, scheduling, and community management for social media.
imageAlt: Social media content calendar showing scheduled posts across platforms
body:
Posting consistently, staying on-brand, and actually engaging with followers takes real time — time most business owners don't have. We plan, create, and post content across your social channels so your presence stays active and consistent.

**What's included:**

- Content calendar and planning
- Post creation and scheduling
- Basic community management (comments, DMs where relevant)
- Monthly performance review

**Who it's for:** Businesses that know they need to be active on social media but don't have the time or team to do it consistently.

process.title: Brand & goals
process.text: We learn your brand voice, audience and what you want social media to achieve.

process.title: Content plan
process.text: We create a content calendar covering what to post and when.

process.title: Create & publish
process.text: We produce and schedule the posts across your channels.

process.title: Engage & review
process.text: We handle basic community management and review performance every month.

benefits: A consistent presence without the daily effort
Content that matches your brand
Comments and messages handled so followers feel heard
A monthly review of what is working

faq.q: Which platforms do you cover?
faq.a: We agree the channels with you based on where your customers actually spend time.

faq.q: Do I approve posts before they go live?
faq.a: We can set up an approval step if you want to review content first.

faq.q: Can you handle replies and DMs?
faq.a: Basic community management, including comments and DMs where relevant, is included.

faq.q: Do you make the images and videos?
faq.a: We create post content as part of the service. Share your own photos if you have them and we will use them.

title: Custom Business Software, Apps & Solutions
summary: When off-the-shelf tools stop being enough, we build exactly what your business needs.
seoTitle: Custom Business Software & App Development | StarBlaze Ventures
seoDescription: Custom software, apps, and solutions built around your specific business workflows.
imageAlt: Custom business software dashboard showing a client-specific workflow tool
body:
Sometimes generic tools stop fitting — a specific workflow, an internal tool, a customer-facing app that doesn't exist yet. We design and build custom software and applications built specifically around how your business actually operates.

**What's included:**

- Requirements discovery and scoping
- Custom app/software design and development
- Integration with your existing tools and data
- Ongoing support and iteration post-launch

**Who it's for:** Businesses that have outgrown off-the-shelf tools, or have a specific operational problem no existing product solves well.

process.title: Discovery & scoping
process.text: We understand the problem, who will use the software, and what done looks like.

process.title: Design
process.text: We plan the workflows and screens and agree on them with you before building.

process.title: Build & integrate
process.text: We develop the software and connect it to your existing tools and data.

process.title: Launch & iterate
process.text: We release it, support your team, and keep improving it based on real use.

benefits: Software that fits how your business actually runs
Fewer workarounds and less copying between tools
Connected to the systems and data you already have
A partner who keeps improving it after launch

faq.q: What kinds of software do you build?
faq.a: Internal tools, customer-facing apps and business systems, built around your specific workflow.

faq.q: Do I own the software?
faq.a: Ownership terms are agreed in writing before work starts.

faq.q: Can you improve something we already have?
faq.a: Yes. We can extend or rework an existing tool as well as build a new one.

faq.q: How do you price custom work?
faq.a: Pricing depends on scope. We scope the project first and then give you a clear quote.
